Item 1 restates the urgency supporting direct execution; item 2 incorrectly links annulment to supervening public interest; item 3 makes an independently false absolute claim about retroactivity; and item 4 states general attributes of administrative fines. categoryScores.reasoning: All three keys are uniquely correct and require the shared stimulus. Sticking would require 10 N of friction, exceeding the 4 N limit. During descent, P accelerates at 2 m/s² and Q and R at 6 m/s², giving tension 16 N. R reaches the floor at 1 s; P and Q then reach their common speed of 4 m/s at 2 s. P's distance through 3 s is 1 + 3 + 4 = 8 m. Q travels 3 + 5 = 8 m before slipping ceases, so friction does -4 × 8 = -32 J. No key-related cap applies.
